title: AI Capability Maximization — Deep Learning, Reasoning & Context Retention
description: Comprehensive roadmap to mathematically maximize PRISM AI capabilities through deep learning integration, advanced reasoning patterns, constant context retention, and full MCP server utilization. Targets surpassing baseline LLM abilities through domain-specific knowledge synthesis.

brief.objective: Maximize AI coding, reasoning, and knowledge synthesis capabilities
emphasis: Deep AI learning from tribal knowledge, resources, JM DIE
Constant context retention across sessions and compactions
Full MCP server utilization (82 dispatchers, 4,296 actions)

engines: AICapabilityMaximizerEngine.ts (650 LOC) — capability metrics, reasoning patterns

sessions.title: Resource Extraction Pipeline
sessions.intent: Complete extraction of patterns from hyperMILL Python scripts, JM DIE programs, and resource folder. Build searchable pattern database.
knowledge_focus: Okuma/Fanuc G-code patterns from JM DIE

criteria: Pattern database searchable via engine API

sessions.title: Advanced Reasoning Pattern Implementation
sessions.intent: Implement Tree-of-Thought, counterfactual reasoning, and causal inference engines. Enable multi-hypothesis generation with EV ranking.

criteria: Multi-hypothesis ranking demonstrates correct EV ordering

sessions.title: Context Retention & Cross-Session State
sessions.intent: Enhance cross-session state persistence, implement hierarchical context compression, and build automatic context checkpointing.

sessions.title: MCP Full Utilization & Integration
sessions.intent: Maximize MCP dispatcher utilization from 3% to 40%+. Wire all new AI engines to dispatchers. Create AI-specific MCP actions.

criteria: All AI engines wired to dispatchers
AI actions callable from PRISM app

units.title: hyperMILL Python Script Pattern Extractor
units.description: Scan 306 hyperMILL Python scripts and extract CAM automation patterns (om.cad.*, om.cam.*, electrode workflows)
units.exit_criteria: 200+ API patterns extracted, categorized by module

units.title: JM DIE Program Pattern Analyzer
units.description: Analyze 22,721 JM DIE programs to extract material-specific cutting parameters, G-code patterns, and controller idioms
units.exit_criteria: 5000+ programs analyzed, 50+ material parameter sets extracted

units.title: Pattern Database & Search Engine
units.description: Build searchable database combining all extracted patterns with fuzzy matching and relevance scoring
units.exit_criteria: Pattern search < 50ms, relevance scores match manual ranking

units.title: Tree-of-Thought Reasoning Engine
units.description: Implement ToT exploration for complex multi-step manufacturing problems with branch pruning and backtracking
units.exit_criteria: Solves 10+ test problems with optimal path, <100ms per step

units.title: Counterfactual Reasoning Engine
units.description: Add counterfactual reasoning for parameter sensitivity analysis ('what if speed was 10% lower?')
units.exit_criteria: Generates valid counterfactuals, sensitivity matches numerical derivative

units.title: Multi-Hypothesis EV Ranker
units.description: Generate 3-5 solution hypotheses and rank by expected value with physics/tribal validation
units.exit_criteria: EV ranking matches expert judgment on 5+ test cases

units.title: Hierarchical Context Compression
units.description: Implement priority-based context loading with compact indices and on-demand expansion
units.completion_notes: Engine + 40-test direct suite shipped pre-2026-05-13. Slot bravo (claude-281195e4) wired 6 dispatcher actions (compression_compress/batch/expand/has/policy/stats) on prism_context with 12 round-trip tests + Zod schemas. All 93 tests pass (40 compression + 53 checkpoint). Exit criterion ≥5:1 compression at medium priority + ≥3:1 at high + <100ms expand all asserted. (Note: 'files_modified.index.ts' kept as historical declaration — actual wiring lives in contextDispatcher.ts + contextActionSchemas.ts.)

units.title: Automatic Context Checkpointing
units.description: Checkpoint state at 15/25/35 edit thresholds with auto-recovery on compaction
units.exit_criteria: Checkpoints at thresholds, recovery restores 95%+ state
units.completion_notes: Engine + 41-test direct suite shipped pre-2026-05-13. Slot bravo (claude-281195e4) wired 8 dispatcher actions (checkpoint_record_edit/should/create/latest/list/recover/ingest/config) on prism_context with 14 round-trip tests + Zod schemas. 95%+ fidelity exit criterion asserted (full-content checkpoint reaches 1.0 fidelity, ≥0.95 threshold met). Edge cases covered: 1MB cap, FIFO prune at 10, schema-version validation, ascending-threshold guard. (Note: original 'files_modified.auto-compact.mjs' deferred — hook integration is a separate orchestration concern, not a U-AIMAX08 exit-criterion.)

units.title: Feature Cascade Enhancement
units.description: Enhance Feature Cascade to propagate new engines/hooks/skills across sessions automatically
units.exit_criteria: New assets visible in next session within 5 seconds

units.title: AI Dispatcher Actions
units.description: Wire all AI engines (capability, resource, training) to MCP dispatchers with full action schemas
units.exit_criteria: All AI engines callable via MCP, 100% action coverage
